title: Retrieval evidence index, contract version 1
description: EVIDENCE-INDEX.json at the root of the retrieval handoff (class evidence_index; listed in SYNC-MANIFEST.json). Metadata only: no binaries cross in Channel A. The consumer uses it to identify each producer scan by SHA-256, follow renames, check multi-page completeness and resolution status before an owner-authorised transfer (Channel B). Serialisation as for the manifest; scans sorted by path.

root.description: Directory of the scans, relative to the producer repository root.

aliases.description: Earlier filenames of the same bytes (the producer's rename history).

record.description: The producer's record key grouping the pages of one record, or null if ungrouped.

complete.description: Whether the record's page set is complete (true), known incomplete (false) or not assessed (null).
